fusions.name: Switching Tail
fusions.desc: Lashes your tail at a target up to 3 tiles away, dealing 5 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full range. It moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mane Snare
fusions.desc: Tosses your mane through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 10% armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 25%, then stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Thickened Coat
fusions.desc: Thickens your coat into a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.

fusions.name: Dense Mane
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You carry 8% physical resistance.
